item.title: New Tom Thumb opens in Argyle with free groceries
item.description: Tom Thumb grocery store is set to open in Argyle on March 6, 2026, featuring 63,000 square feet of space, a bakery, deli, floral department, meat and seafood counter, an in-store Starbucks coffee kiosk, a pharmacy with a drive-thru lane and Drive-Up-N-Go grocery pickup services.

item.title: Experience wine and wildflowers at Texas Hill Country wineries
item.description: The Texas Hill Country Wineries Wine & Wildflower Journey will take place from March 23 to April 17, allowing passport holders to visit more than 55 wineries and enjoy complimentary tastings, discounts, and views of the region's wildflowers.

item.title: CityVet Waxahachie opens March 16, offers personalized pet care
item.description: CityVet Waxahachie, a new veterinary practice owned and led by Dr. James Blake Watson, is set to open on March 16, offering a relationship-driven approach to pet care.

item.title: Gerber photo search 2026: Call for entries now open
item.description: Gerber has opened the call for entries for the 2026 Gerber Photo Search: Behind the Baby, which honors both babies and their parents and offers a main prize of $50,000 and a new category for children ages 3-5 with a prize of $10,000.

item.title: Skip Schumaker named 21st manager of Texas Rangers
item.description: SURPRISE, Ariz (KFDX/KJTL) — Skip Schumaker was officially introduced as the 21st full-time manager of the Texas Rangers on Oct. 3, 2025. The move marks a return to the dugout for Schumaker, who previously served as a front office adviser for the organization. item.title: Fifteen Parkland nurses honored for excellence in care
item.description: Fifteen registered nurses at Parkland Health have been recognized by two local organizations for their dedication to the Dallas County community and their excellence in nursing.

item.title: Celebrate Pi Day with Blaze Pizza's BOGO deal
item.description: Blaze Pizza will celebrate Pi Day on March 14 by offering a second 11-inch pizza for $3.14 to customers who purchase an 11-inch pizza at regular price, and those who visit a restaurant on March 14 will also receive a digital code for a buy-one, get-one-free 11-inch pizza to be used on a future visit.

item.title: Mountain Mike's Pizza launches Pi Day & St. Patrick's deals
item.description: Mountain Mike's Pizza is offering exclusive promotions for Pi Day and St. Patrick's Day to members of its Mountain Rewards loyalty program, including a discounted medium one-topping pizza for $3.14 on March 14 and 20% off a single order on March 17.

item.title: Dallas Trinity FC & Pizzana team up for Women's History Month
item.description: Dallas Trinity FC has partnered with Pizzana to debut the "Pegasus Pie" in celebration of Women's History Month, featuring a player meet-and-greet and free pizza slices.

item.title: Dr. Tonya Stafford: From human trafficking survivor to Remarkable Woman
item.description: Dr. Tonya Stafford, a human trafficking survivor, is the 2026 Remarkable Women winner, and she now helps other survivors through her nonprofit It's Going To Be Ok, which provides comprehensive, trauma-informed care.
